raw.details:
VibeX code 26 — Build something worth sharing.

Join Admitiy for a free, 12-hour online hackathon hosted on Discord on 15 November 2026, from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM IST. Bring your ideas, build a project, and compete for a Winner’s Certificate.

How to Register

  1. Complete registration with your name and email address.
  2. You may share a link to previous work, GitHub, or a portfolio. This is optional and is not required to participate.

Who Can Participate

  • Students, beginners, and experienced builders are welcome.
  • Participate solo or in a team of up to 4 members.
  • Members from different colleges and specialisations may team up.
  • Entry is completely free.

Format and Rules

  • The hackathon runs from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM IST on 15 November 2026.
  • The challenge brief and submission instructions will be shared at the start on Discord.
  • Submit your project by 9:00 PM IST.
  • Include a short description, a project or repository link, and a demo or screenshots.
  • Build your submission during the event.
  • Disclose any pre-existing code, third-party resources, and AI tools used.
  • Respect licences, credit sources, and do not submit another person’s work as your own.
  • Be respectful to all participants.
  • Projects will be assessed on usefulness, originality, implementation, and clarity of presentation.

Prize

  • First place: Winner’s Certificate.
